reviews.comment: Class was a little poorly structured with the entire project not having a rubric at all. Nice person during office hours, lectures tended to ramble and slides were slightly messy but had good content. Participation was ill-defined as a grading criteria. 8% extra credit total on homeworks. Course was messy but easy if you do the extra credit.

Very easy class and learned a lot about modern ML topics (including LLMs) and how they work. Graded on 1 exam, 3 semi-large assignments, one reading assignment, and a final project. Professor Huang is very understanding wants you to get a good grade.

This professor has an awful personality. She is a very very negative person. You can hardly hear anything insightful or learnable from her mouth. You will get negative experience no matter how you interact with her.

Also, this professor is not professional at all. She rejects to learn or accept any technology or knowledge that is new and frontier.

I felt that I learned a lot through the lectures and programming assignments. Her lectures are methodical and include helpful examples. She often asks students to bring up their confusion and ask questions. you can tell she tries to be fair and cares about her students. if you show up to class and pay attention success is definitely achievable.

I've never met a ruder professor at Texas A&M. Definitely makes the class harder than it needs to be. Doesn't explain very well. Criterias doesn't make sense. Overall, not a good experience. Out of touch
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: The most unprofessional prof... She has no concept of reality. She almost required students to buy a printer and scanner to take an exam during covid19. Then she makes the final project presentations 2min long (which is a semester of work), cutting people off even if they barely go over the time. If you present on day 1, you're at a disadvantage.

I have never seen a professor limit a semester long presentation to two minutes with no exceptions, no room for flexibility, and no respect for the students' work. This lady has issues. She's rude. Grading criteria is unclear. Grades take forever to be returned. She's careless and does not care for her students. Why did this lady become a professor
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Huang is kind and ready to help students when they need it during Office Hours. Her homework aren't too difficult but yet interesting enough to learn the materials. Her accents are improving.
